name: CHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Colorado Springs, CO · Norris Penrose Event Center
headline: CHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: The deepest state final of the week. Niwot (No. 4 boys, No. 7 girls), No. 8 Boulder and No. 9 ThunderRidge girls, plus Northfield's Abdi Hassan (No. 2 nationally), Coronado's Oliver Horton (No. 10) and Eaton's Delaney Reuter (No. 9 girls). · Nine races, first at 9:00 a.m. MT; 5A girls 1:00 p.m., 5A boys 2:20 p.m.
